faqs.question: How does polyaspartic epoxy hold up against Ontario winter road salt?
faqs.answer: Unlike hardware-store epoxy paint kits that peel after one winter, our system utilizes a mechanical diamond grind bond and an industrial aliphatic polyaspartic topcoat. Road salt, calcium chloride brine, and slush cannot penetrate the chemical cross-links.

faqs.question: Can I park my vehicle on it without hot-tire pickup?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our polyaspartic topcoats withstand heat ratings up to 150°C. Standard tires coming off the 401 or 410 during peak summer will never lift or delaminate our coatings.

faqs.question: How long does installation take?
faqs.answer: Most standard 2-car and 3-car residential garages are completed in just 1 to 2 days. You can walk on the floor within 6 to 8 hours and park your vehicles after 24 to 48 hours.

faqs.question: Do you repair existing pitted, salt-damaged, or cracked concrete?
faqs.answer: Yes! Preparation is 80% of a lasting floor. We diamond-grind away all surface contaminants, then fill and stitch every crack and salt-pitted crater with ultra-fast curing polyurea mender before coating.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with STEPX EPOXY floors?
faqs.answer: We back our full-flake residential polyaspartic garage installations with a comprehensive 15-year adhesion and anti-peeling warranty.

faqs.question: Who will be doing the actual work on my floor?
faqs.answer: Kyle oversees every single project personally. We do not subcontract to day laborers; our trained craftsmen handle prep, repairs, and chemical applications.

faqs.question: Can you install metallic epoxy in finished basements?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our metallic epoxy system is zero-VOC and odorless, making it completely safe for occupied residential basements and living spaces.

faqs.question: How do you clean an epoxy floor once installed?
faqs.answer: Epoxy floors are virtually maintenance-free. A simple dust mop or damp mopping with warm water and mild dish soap or Simple Green is all that's required.

faqs.question: What happens if there are oil stains in my existing garage concrete?
faqs.answer: Our commercial degreasers and diamond grinding cut past the oil-saturated layer of concrete to guarantee uncompromised primer adhesion.

faqs.question: Do you provide free on-site consultations in the Hamilton & Burlington area?

faqs.question: How quickly can your emergency roofing crew arrive in Brampton?
faqs.answer: Our emergency dispatch team operates 24/7 across Brampton, Caledon, and Mississauga, typically arriving within 2 hours to install secure emergency tarps and prevent interior water damage.

faqs.question: What causes the majority of roof leaks in Ontario homes?
faqs.answer: Over 70% of leaks occur around vent pipes, skylights, chimneys, or in valleys due to dried rubber gaskets, failed caulking, or winter ice damming where frozen water pushes under shingles.

faqs.question: Do you lay new shingles over old ones (roof-over)?
faqs.answer: No. We always perform a full tear-off. Shingling over old shingles hides rot, voids manufacturer warranties, adds dangerous weight, and prevents proper ice and water shield installation.

faqs.question: How do you protect my driveway, landscaping, and pets?
faqs.answer: We set up heavy tarp chutes, protect flowerbeds with plywood shields, and run high-powered industrial magnetic sweepers across your driveway, lawn, and sidewalks 3 times before departing.

faqs.question: Are your roof replacements backed by warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes. You receive a 50-year manufacturer material warranty on our architectural shingles and a dedicated 15-year Diamond Roof workmanship guarantee.

faqs.question: Do you also repair or replace eavestroughs, soffits, and fascia?
faqs.answer: Yes. A healthy roof requires a complete exterior drainage and ventilation system. We custom-extrude 5-inch seamless aluminum gutters on-site.

faqs.question: How can I tell if my roof needs a repair versus a full replacement?
faqs.answer: If missing or curled shingles are localized to one section and the roof is under 15 years old, a repair is often possible. If granules are washing out into gutters or shingles are brittle across the roof, replacement is more cost-effective.

faqs.question: Do you offer written warranties?
